name: sloprail-marketplace
description: sloprail plugin marketplace (in-repo) — maps a harness's lifecycle onto sloprail's session subcommands

plugins.name: sloprail
plugins.description: Enforces a project's declared guardrails at the moments its harness can pause. The only Claude-Code-specific part of sloprail: it maps that harness's lifecycle names onto sr-session's subcommands, so nothing inside the engine knows whose lifecycle it is running under.
